meta.name: pdf
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to do anything with PDF files. This includes reading or extracting text/tables from PDFs, combining or merging multiple PDFs into one, splitting PDFs apart, rotating pages, adding watermarks, creating new PDFs, filling PDF forms, encrypting/decrypting PDFs, extracting images, and OCR on scanned PDFs to make them searchable. If the user mentions a .pdf file or asks to produce one, use this skill.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 处理PDF的合并、拆分、提取、加密与OCR
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要处理PDF文档,如合并拆分或提取内容
copy.tagline_en: Manage PDF files: merge, split, extract text, fill forms, and OCR
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often work with PDF documents and need to combine, split, or extract content

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能处理 PDF 文件：读取并提取文字/表格，合并或拆分 PDF，旋转页面，添加水印，新建 PDF，填写表单，加密/解密，提取图片，还能对扫描版 PDF 做 OCR 使其可搜索。会实际运行代码或命令行工具完成。
howto.when: 当用户提到 PDF 文件、要求进行任何 PDF 相关操作（如提取、合并、填写表单等），或要求生成一个 PDF 时触发。

say.text: 把这两个PDF合并成一个文件
提取这个PDF里的表格并转成Excel

say.note: Claude会生成水印页并合并到每页。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can process PDF files: read and extract text/tables, merge or split PDFs, rotate pages, add watermarks, create new PDFs, fill forms, encrypt/decrypt, extract images, and OCR scanned PDFs to make them searchable. It runs Python libraries or command-line tools to do so.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions a PDF file, asks for any PDF-related operation (e.g., extraction, merging, form filling, etc.), or requests producing a PDF.

say_en.text: Merge these two PDFs into one file.
say_en.note: Claude will use pypdf or qpdf to merge them.

say_en.text: Extract the tables in this PDF and save them to Excel.
say_en.note: Claude will use pdfplumber to extract tables and save as xlsx.

say_en.text: Add a 'Confidential' watermark to this PDF.
say_en.note: Claude will create a watermark page and merge it into every page.
